representation_plans.learner_operation: Compare trigger, membrane-protein action, and immediate intracellular consequence.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A four-row text table names voltage-gated channel, ligand-gated channel, receptor enzyme, and G protein–coupled receptor with their trigger and first controlled step; it does not mark an item response.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Locate the first broken arrow in a short signaling sequence.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: An ordered list states receptor activation, G-protein nucleotide exchange, and effector regulation without solving the current item.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Distinguish a four-fused-ring steroid core from an isoprene-derived terpene or terpenoid scaffold.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Text identifies ring count, isoprene-unit construction, oxygen-bearing modification, and charge without naming the scored classification.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Relate polarity and charge to membrane passage, then use supplied receptor evidence.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A linear text sequence gives scaffold, polarity, membrane passage, receptor location, and cellular action as conditional steps.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Locate a major gland before assigning a product.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A top-to-bottom list gives brain, neck, adrenal, pancreas, gonad, and their major gland names without highlighting an item response.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Map source tissue to hormone product and chemical type.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text table lists source, representative product, and broad hormone class in logical reading order.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Separate hormone synthesis from axonal transport, storage, and release.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: An ordered text sequence states hypothalamic synthesis, axonal transport, posterior-pituitary storage, and release without identifying a scored option.
